admin.users.ownRole.title: Change your own role?
admin.users.ownRole.description: You're about to change your own permission role. If you lower your permissions you may lose access to parts of the administration panel immediately.
admin.backup.title: Backup & Restore Database
admin.backup.noPassword.title: No password entered
admin.backup.noFile.title: No file selected
admin.backup.backupDescription: Create and download a Database Backup. This process will generate an unencrypted file containing all the data currently stored in the database, which can be restored at a later time.
admin.backup.restoreDescription: Restoring your database from a file will completely replace your existing database. It is strongly discouraged to restore a database from another version and it is not possible to restore databases from different database systems.
admin.backup.passwordHint: The database password configured on the server (DB_PASSWORD), not your account password.
admin.backup.forbidden: Only administrators can back up or restore the database.
admin.backup.networkError: The server could not be reached: {message}
admin.backup.signInAgain: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
admin.backup.confirmRestore.title: Replace the server database?
admin.backup.confirmRestore.description: All data currently stored on the server (users, games, settings and everything else) will be replaced with the contents of "{file}". This cannot be undone. Create a backup first if you might still need the current data.
admin.backup.restoredDescription: The server restored the backup and migrated it to its version. If your account changed with the restore, sign in again.
admin.folderTags.error.folder: Rule {index}: enter a relative library folder without traversal.
admin.folderTags.error.tags: Rule {index}: enter 1–20 tags of at most 64 characters.
admin.folderTags.savedWithFailures: Rules saved. Refreshed {applied} games. {failed} games could not be refreshed; reindex to retry.
admin.folderTags.description: Apply tags automatically to games in a library folder and its descendants. Rules are stored on the server and apply to every game version, including future imports. Saving refreshes existing games.
admin.access.description: Restricted games are visible only to administrators and the selected users. With no selected users, only administrators have access.
admin.metrics.description: Reported completed client actions. Browser download handoffs are not counted. Users can disable reporting; restricted activity respects their sharing preference.
admin.libraryDefaults.title: Library defaults
admin.libraryDefaults.description: Shared with users who can access this game. Empty values clear a saved default.
admin.register.title: Register new user
admin.register.requirementsFailed: Failed to load registration requirements. Cannot submit.
admin.diagnostics.statusFailed: Could not read the server status.
admin.diagnostics.recache.title: Refresh all game metadata?
admin.diagnostics.recache.description: This contacts configured metadata providers for the entire library. Manual metadata and mappings are preserved. Large libraries may take time and provider limits still apply.
admin.diagnostics.recache.queued: Queued metadata refresh for {count} games. The server processes it in the background; refresh the logs to inspect progress.
admin.diagnostics.description: Inspect recent server logs or refresh provider metadata for the library. Logs are filtered by the server; review their contents before sharing them.
